strategies.text: Two spider adds come with him: kill them first. Cleanse the Leech Poison on the tank.
Hits hard; Knockout removes nearly half the tank's health and stuns, so keep the tank high.
Easy optional fight after five waves of adds with short gaps: conserve mana. Gains threat fast and uses Leech Poison.
Starts after three add waves. Chilled on melee attackers and Life Drain on the tank: stun him as Life Drain starts. Frost Nova too.
Only a short Anti-Magic Shield (3 s). Do not pull him with nearby ghoul packs.
Easy: his only ability is Flamestrike. Move out of it; a stun stops casts.

notes: Forever-only dungeon (the open Ruins of Lordaeron above the Undercity): no uiMapID, use instanceMapID 2999. Level range is the client table (15-22; NeedRoll 15-20). Only Witherfang (King's Alley) and Viktor (chimney southwest of the Lordamere Overlook) have a place in Method; both are estimates against the map's room labels. The other four bosses have no position. No NPC IDs (no open source for the Forever IDs). NeedRoll was used only as a cross-check. Alliance quest NPC inside: Captain Truman (Abominable Creatures), no position. Method lists the Crest of Lordaeron as spawning behind a door near the Baron, near Bjork's patrol path and at the end of rooftop paths with gargoyles. Horde quest givers are outside. Alliance travel: boat via Southshore.
